title: How did Cuban War of Independence lead to Treaty of Paris (1898)?
question: How did Cuban War of Independence lead to Treaty of Paris (1898)?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Cuban War of Independence (1895) to Treaty of Paris (1898) (1898): 1 of cause and effect, 1 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
